attributes.headline: The Reuse Stress Test
attributes.subhead: A bounded software-factory run to measure whether mature Boxel models, fields, components, and platform tools can compress the path to a complete Layer 06 application.

cardInfo.name: Factory Trial 01 — Vendor Readiness
cardInfo.summary: A measurable Layer 06 build proposal designed to test module reuse, catalog discovery, typed commands, build time, quality, and token savings.
cardInfo.notes: Proposed 2026-07-21. The time and token targets are hypotheses, not observed results. The factory run must preserve the frozen control estimate and fill the run record with actual telemetry.
